title: Ablaze Tunisian Provola Kebabs
description: Charred, snappy kebabs packed with provola cheese and Tunisian spices, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch or dinner.
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 15 minutes to prevent burning.
In a bowl, toss diced provola with 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, chili flakes, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Thread provola cubes onto soaked skewers, spacing them evenly, and set aside to marinate for 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and pour 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the kebabs to the skillet and sear each side for 2 minutes until a golden crust forms.
Reduce heat to medium and continue cooking, turning occasionally, until the cheese inside is melted and the exterior is charred, about 4 minutes total.
Transfer the finished kebabs onto a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the kebabs for a fresh finish.
If desired, serve the kebabs over a bed of fluffy couscous or with pita bread.
Enjoy hot and crispy, perfect for a lazy Sunday meal.
